enrollment_evidence_quote: Please review and sign enrollment services agreement via DocuSign.
phase_activation_evidence: The first phase is what we're doing today. Activation phase is where we're establishing your account through Beyond Finance.
phase_traction_evidence: Months 4 to 9 is when we get into phase 2, those negotiations are being put in place. You start to see your balances start to shrink.
phase_momentum_evidence: By month 10 usually is when you start to hit momentum as those accounts are starting to get resolved to a 0 balance.
phase_graduation_evidence: By phase 4, once you totally finish paying off the debt, all your debts are resolved, you graduate and move forward with a clean slate.
credit_impact_evidence: In the beginning, you do have a temporary setback to your score.
payments_withheld_evidence: You're going to stop paying these creditors directly and those semimonthly deposits go into the escrow account.
accounts_may_close_evidence: You're going to wanna stop the usage of the cards. They eventually will close them out.
adjustment_period_evidence: Typically by month 4 is when most clients start to report that their scores are starting to stabilize, so there's an adjustment period at the start.
violation_reason: Agent covered all four phases and all required downsides.
